Gulf-backed developer secures $12 billion tourism deal

A Gulf-backed developer, with existing projects in three African countries, has secured a $12 billion deal to develop a luxury island tourism hub. Separately, a French asset manager is investing in Dubai, viewing it as a growing regional wealth center.
